meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: Claude 会写小脚本控制浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据,也可用来测试网页。页面状态在多次脚本运行之间保持,任务可以一步步推进。
howto.when: 当你要求导航网站、填表、截图或做浏览器自动化时接管,例如说 “go to [url]”、“click on”、“scrape” 等。

say.text: 打开 example.com,告诉我页面标题和网址
say.note: 会启动浏览器并返回标题与 URL

say.text: 登录这个网站,填好表单后截图给我看
say.note: 截图保存到 tmp/ 目录

say.text: 抓取 Hacker News 首页的文章标题
say.note: 先用 ARIA 快照定位元素再提取

howto.what_en: Claude writes small scripts to drive a browser: navigate pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, and scrape data, and can test web apps. Page state persists across script runs, so a task can be done step by step.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, or automate browser workflows — e.g. "go to [url]", "click on", or "scrape".

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me the page title and URL
say_en.note: Launches a browser and returns title and URL

say_en.text: Log into this site, fill out the form, then screenshot it for me
Scrape the article titles from the Hacker News homepage
say_en.note: Uses an ARIA snapshot to find elements
